svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A folded tray, open toward the plate: 236 long, 165 tall, 40 deep,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a 12 mm flange on each end that screws to the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the blank: back 236 x 165; top and bottom walls 40 deep;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end walls 40 deep plus the 12 mm flanges. Relief holes 3 mm at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each corner. Fold the walls 90 degrees, then the flanges outward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drive motor: 8 mm shaft hole 90 toward the row, 41 up from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge; motor screw holes from the motor's datasheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Brush motor (lower only): 10 mm shaft hole on the centre line,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 122 up; screw holes from its datasheet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flanges: three 4.5 mm holes each, 6 from the outer edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upper housing: 79 tall, 1.5 mm sheet, drive motor hole only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the tray sits flat on the plate all round its rim.
